title: Util.log has been removed
summary: Node.js removed util.log (DEP0059: documentation-only since v6.0.0, runtime deprecation since v22.0.0, end-of-life since v23.0.0).
replacement: a third-party logging library, or console.log(new Date().toLocaleString(), message)

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of util.log with a third-party logging library, or console.log(new Date().toLocaleString(), message).

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.
